about: Prover tiers of the obligation loop (plan A5), cheapest first; route.py reads name and max_attempts, tools/oblig/dispatch_kernel.py the rest. `agent` is the agent a wave spawns (null: no model): the Haiku tiers run `rocq-prover` (.omp/agents/rocq-prover.md: a Rocq prover prompt, no built-in tools, only the kernel prover tools the driver passes); `model` is the model the agent must resolve to (checked against the session's resolvedModel after each answer); `per_call_model` true passes `model` to agent(..., model=) (dispatch_kernel.spawn_options), which needs task.perCallModel eval, the model in task.perCallModelAllow and an operator grant (user config modelRoles.prover: anthropic/claude-haiku-5-5; a project agent's frontmatter grants nothing), and no task.agentModelOverrides entry for the agent. opus-medium stays on the bundled `task` agent; `agent: rocq-prover` with `per_call_model: true` also runs it (tested: anthropic/claude-opus-5-5:medium resolves, the default role grants it). haiku-low has one sample: in the prover A/B of 2026-11-23 on 12 open keysToOwnedSlice goals (_build/agents/aa/haikuloop-ab/RESULT.md), rocq-prover with one sample closed 3 at 0.66M tokens, with best-of-3 4 at 2.58M, and sonic with best-of-3 4 at 8.13M; haiku-high (rocq-prover at :high, the next rung) closed every goal the others did. `mechanical` is CONTROL_TACTIC of tools/residuals/residual_package.py. `max_prompt_bytes` is the prompt bound of every goal class without its own bound; a class's `max_prompt_bytes` in routing.json replaces it, capped by the tier's `max_class_prompt_bytes` (replay.prompt_bound). sonnet-medium stays out until the replay's 50% rule (routing.json haiku_union) asks for it. `check_tool` (default false) gives each prover of the tier the kernel tool check_proof (tools/oblig/drive.py ProofProbe: a compile of its one goal in a scratch dir, the error clipped to CHECK_ERROR_BYTES), at most `check_calls` calls per attempt (default 6). Prover tools (tools/oblig/drive.py, drive_kernel.py): `check_tool` with `check_calls` gives check_proof; `lookup_calls` gives lookup and search (one budget); `counterexample_calls` gives check_counterexample, and with it a `false` answer needs a confirmed counterexample; `samples` is N of a best-of-N round (a class's routing.json `samples` replaces it; route.py counts a round as one attempt). `cost_weight` is a PLACEHOLDER relative price per token (haiku-low 1) for report.py's cost-weighted tokens per closed goal: replace these numbers with real prices.
